plan.goal: Calculate Terrain Ruggedness Index (TRI) from the PA DEM using focal statistics. Compute the square root of the sum of squared differences between each cell and its 8 neighboring cells.
plan.notes: TRI formula: sqrt(sum((z_cell - z_neighbor)^2 for all 8 neighbors)). This produces a new single-band raster where higher values indicate more rugged terrain.

plan.goal: Compute zonal statistics of the ruggedness index for each county polygon. Calculate mean, min, max, and standard deviation of TRI pixel values within each county boundary.
plan.notes: Join key to county shapefile is COUNTYFP or NAME. Output must include COUNTYFP, mean_TRI, min_TRI, max_TRI, std_TRI. Export as CSV to avoid parquet dependency issues.

plan.goal: Join the TRI zonal statistics from CSV to the Pennsylvania counties shapefile as new attribute fields and export as a Shapefile.
plan.notes: New fields to add: mean_TRI (float64), min_TRI (float64), max_TRI (float64), std_TRI (float64). Join on COUNTYFP. Preserve all original county fields and geometry.
